newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 4.

text.p: -- MCI Communications Corp said it plans to merge with British Telecommunications Plc in a $22 billion deal that values each MCI share at $36 to $39.60.
Trading in MCI shares was halted on Friday at 30-1/4 and the company requested a continued halt through the weekend.
-- J.C. Penney Co Inc agreed to buy drug store chain Eckerd Corp in a $3.3 billion cash, stock and debt deal. Penney will launch a $35-a-share cash tender offer for 37.1 million shares of Eckerd.
In a second stage, Eckerd holders will receive 0.6604 Penney share for each Eckerd share, based on Penney's closing price of $53 on Friday. Eckerd shares closed at 28-3/4.

-- Physician Corp of America and Sierra Health Services Inc said they would merge in a deal that values each Physician Corp share at about $13. Sierra closed at 28-7/8, and Physician Corp closed at 10-5/8.
-- Voice Powered Technology International Inc said it expected its third quarter results to be hurt by order delays, operational problems and first half losses. Shares closed at 11/16 on Friday.
